name: My Zypp Stikks 1g Infused Preroll - Pineapple Zing
description:
Infused and ready to spark. The My Zypp Stikks Pineapple Zing is a 1-gram infused pre-roll packed with quality flower for a bolder, more potent smoke. No grinding, no rolling, just light it and go.

Pineapple Zing brings a bright, tropical profile: juicy sweet pineapple up front with a tangy citrus snap and a crisp, refreshing finish.

1G infused pre-roll — quality flower infused for extra potency
Signature Pineapple Zing flavor — juicy pineapple with a tangy citrus snap
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

My Zypp Stikks Pineapple Zing is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
